C3.1 R0 · 19 OCT 2026 · INCHES UNLESS MARKED · PRELIMINARY — NOT FOR FABRICATION
Separate cap, matched spacers, thicker sole, side gussets and actual nominal weld volumes.
C45_44 example; all8 collars are unique global underframe pieces.
Eight collars connect four rail lines to retained underframe crossmembers. Twelve adjoining rail fit envelopes change; saw lengths await fitup.
The 3/4in deep socket candidate has1.02in OD and3in length; exact inserted envelopes are checked in verification.json. Torque is not released.
PJP bevels and nominal weld volumes are shown; weld appearance does not establish penetration, fatigue life or WPS qualification.
The aft foot/weld toe has zero nominal strip margin atX60. Truck/bolster integration, tolerances and full-coach load paths remain separate gates.
